scoring_justification: Result-level compare; full MD recompute infeasible in verifier sandbox. Tolerances and trend enforcement provide a reliable reproduction check.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference bulk thermal conductivity of UO2+x at 800 K and 1600 K, from Fig. 6 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 6 and text: final renormalized bulk thermal conductivity after size extrapolation using Busker potential and direct-method MD.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Digitized from Fig. 6 and cross-checked with the paper's description of the saturation regime.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the original published results of the study, not fabricated. They serve as the authoritative reference for quantitative comparison.

outputs.description: Bulk thermal conductivity of UO2+x at 800 K and 1600 K after size extrapolation and renormalization. The checker compares the reported values to hidden reference values derived from the paper with appropriate relative tolerances and checks that the conductivity decreases monotonically with increasing x at each temperature.

output_contract.notes: The agent must perform the full molecular dynamics simulations; the output must be derived from the agent's own computations.

rubric.description: Compare each (x, T) pair's kappa_WmK to gold reference with relative tolerances: 15% for gold > 2.0 W/mK, 20% for gold <= 2.0 W/mK. Also check monotonic decreasing trend with increasing x for each temperature. Weight: 0.8 for point accuracy, 0.2 for monotonic trend.
